definitions.gloss: special edition; a version of a publication, product, or broadcast produced for a particular occasion or with additional content
definitions.explanation: A version of a magazine, book, DVD, broadcast, or product that differs from the standard release — often containing bonus content, premium packaging, or commemorative features. Used broadly across publishing, entertainment, and consumer goods.

examples.japanese: ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{特別版|とくべつばん}DVD⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought the special edition DVD of the movie.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今月|こんげつ}→今月：00720_kongetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雑誌|ざっし}→雑誌：00686_zasshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{特別版|とくべつばん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{付録|ふろく}→付録：06206_furoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ついて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: This month's magazine is a special edition and comes with a supplement.

examples.japanese: ⟦{創刊|そうかん}→創刊：11923_soukan⟧50⟦{周年|しゅうねん}→周年：09520_shuunen⟧⟦{記念|きねん}→記念：00232_kinen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{特別版|とくべつばん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発売|はつばい}→発売：04315_hatsubai⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A special edition commemorating the 50th anniversary of the magazine's founding was released.

notes:
Combines ⟦{特別|とくべつ}→特別：01120_tokubetsu⟧ (special) and {版|ばん} (edition, version). The {版|ばん} suffix is used for different versions or editions of published or produced works.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {特別版|とくべつばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発売|はつばい}→発売：04315_hatsubai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to release a special edition
- ⟦{記念|きねん}→記念：00232_kinen⟧{特別版|とくべつばん}: commemorative special edition
- {特別版|とくべつばん}⟦{付録|ふろく}→付録：06206_furoku⟧: special edition supplement/bonus
- ⟦{限定|げんてい}→限定：10997_gentei⟧{特別版|とくべつばん}: limited special edition

RELATED {〜版|ばん} COMPOUNDS:
- {通常版|つうじょうばん}: standard edition, regular edition
- ⟦{豪華版|ごうかばん}→豪華版：24861_goukaban⟧: deluxe edition — an especially lavish version with premium extras
- ⟦{普及版|ふきゅうばん}→普及版：24869_fukyuuban⟧: popular/affordable edition — a cheaper mass-market version
- ⟦{限定版|げんていばん}→限定版：17391_genteiban⟧: limited edition — produced in restricted quantities
- ⟦{改訂版|かいていばん}→改訂版：17716_kaiteiban⟧: revised edition

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{限定版|げんていばん}→限定版：17391_genteiban⟧: limited edition — emphasizes scarcity (limited number produced), while {特別版|とくべつばん} emphasizes special content or occasion
- {増刊号|ぞうかんごう}: special issue (of a magazine) — an extra issue outside the regular schedule
